entities.name: Histidinol-phosphate aminotransferase
observations: The 357-residue query is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q609W4 and belongs to the Aminotran_1_2 family (PF00155.28; residues 25–347).
Curated homologs assign EC 2.6.1.9 and pyridoxal 5'-phosphate dependence.
The enzyme functions in step 7 of L-histidine biosynthesis.

entities.name: Histidinol-phosphate transamination
observations: Reaction is mapped to Rhea RHEA:23744 and EC 2.6.1.9.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5'-phosphate
observations: PLP is the required cofactor for the histidinol-phosphate aminotransferase reaction.

entities.name: L-histidine biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme catalyzes step 7 of 9 in the pathway from phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate to L-histidine.
